 Saoirse Ronan’s husband misses out on James Bond role
 By Bronwyn O'Neill | 
 16/11/2026 | 
 Comments 
 Share with
 Instagram/hairbyadir 
 Saoirse Ronan’s husband, Jack Lowden, was in the running to take on the role of James Bond.
 He was amongst the favourites to don the tux alongside Callum Turner and Jack O’Connor.
 However, in a shocking twist, the news was confirmed this week that Twilight star, Robert Pattinson will be the new 007.
 The news was confirmed on the 007 Instagram with a shot of Robert in a sleek suit wielding a gun.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by James Bond 007 (@007) 
The caption reads: “Robert Pattinson is James Bond.”
 But Jack won’t be resting on his laurels.
 His Apple TV+ show, Slow Horses, has been renewed for a ninth and 10th season.
 The sixth season of the show just finished airing in October and the seventh season is currently in production.
 Instagram/jack.lowden 
 James Bond hasn’t graced our screens since 2021’s No Time To Die , where the iconic spy met his demise — only for an on-screen credit to promise his eventual return.
 While Jack missed out on the role, we’re holding out hope that Saoirse will have better luck.
 The Irish actress has revealed that she would love the chance to play a Bond villain, admitting that she is “dead serious” about the idea.
 Speaking to Empire while promoting her upcoming film Bad Apples, Saoirse said she is keen to explore darker characters in the future.
 Jack Lowden Pic: Pascal Le Segretain 
 “I want to go dark,” she told the publication. “I said that I wanted to be a Bond villain and I’m dead serious.”
 Explaining why the idea appeals to her, the actress said she would particularly like to see a young female villain take on the role.
 “I think it would be really interesting, having a young female villain.
 “Especially for girls and women, to see someone who can just take all that pent-up anger and direct it somewhere; there’s something interesting in that dramatically,” she said.
 “So I would love to do more of that.”
